items.title: Biogen (BIIB) Stock Could Be 48% Below Fair Value On New Dravet Data
items.summary: Biogen stock has delivered a strong 57.2% return over the past year, yet investors are faced with a split verdict on value as a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate points to a large discount while earnings based multiples screen the shares as expensive. The result is a low overall value score that conflicts with what the DCF suggests. Over the latest 1 year window, Biogen has returned 57.2%, which puts recent share price momentum firmly ahead of its longer term track...
